items.text: Cyber attacks risk financial loss, damage, and disruption. We protect your business with firewalls, antivirus, monitoring, and staff training.

items.text: Moving to Microsoft 365 is easy! We will manage the entire process for you and ensure all of your emails and data is safely moved over.

items.text: Connect and collaborate work in a protected and accommodating way, all in one virtual phone system for you and your teams.

items.text: Our all-in-one Cloud VoIP solution lets you seamlessly switch between video calls, messaging, and phone calls on one platform.

items.title: Contact Centre
items.text: Transform customer and employees experiences through intelligent routing, conversational AI, agent assistance, and insights & analytics.

items.title: Leased Lines
items.text: Simple, smart, and affordable with instant setup & award-winning care – ideal for freelancers, start-ups & small businesses.

items.title: Sim Only
items.text: Skip the added costs of paying off hardware and allow flexibility with your mobile contracts, including 4G and 5G at no extra cost.

items.title: Mobile With Handset
items.text: With one tap, switch calls between a desk phone, a mobile device, and a softphone. One-click converts phone calls to video conferences.

items.title: Mobile Internet
items.text: Mobile broadband offers secure 4G and 5G connectivity. We provide tailored solutions and great deals for your business needs.

items.title: Guest WiFi
items.text: A quick, cloud-based overlay for your existing WiFi, requiring no extra hardware and managed easily through an online portal.

items.title: Business Broadband
